brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights condemned Israeli Occupation Forces for forcibly displacing 2,500 Palestinians and imposing collective punishment in Hebron, in the southern West Bank. The centre said the military has conducted widespread retaliatory measures against civilians in the area.

The allegations mark the latest in a series of reported Israeli military operations in the occupied territory that rights groups say target civilian populations.
dek: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) strongly condemns the Israeli Occupation Forces’ (IOF) imposition of collective punishment and widespread retaliatory measures against Palestinian civilians in Hebron, in the southern West Bank.
title: Israel displaces 2,500 Palestinians in Hebron crackdown
